OVER 300 MILLION SOLD!

Carmen T. Colón, CEO & Founder of The Carmen Colón Homes Team, is an expert listing advisor and has a track record of creating the best marketing strategies, selling homes fast, and commanding more per square foot than other listing agents in the Fort Hood area.

We have an office in Killeen and over 90% of our real estate transactions are in Killeen, Harker Heights, Nolanville, Copperas Cove, Salado, Jarrell, Belton, Temple, Lampasas, and Kempner. We serve clients who want a personalized experience when selling their homes or purchasing a new home. Clients choose to work with us because we supply crucial expert advice on pricing strategies, negotiation tactics, relocation information, and local housing trends.
